title: parameterize() leaves separators at the start and end of the slug
body:
`parameterize` in `inflection/__init__.py` produces slugs with a
leading or trailing separator when the text starts or ends with
punctuation:

```python
>>> inflection.parameterize("Hello, World!")
'hello-world-'   # expected 'hello-world'
>>> inflection.parameterize("  (draft) notes", separator="_")
'_draft_notes'   # expected 'draft_notes'
```

Expected: no leading or trailing separator, for the default "-" and
for a custom separator. Runs of separators inside the slug are still
collapsed to one.
provenance: upstream code at a pinned commit with an injected regression; the oracle is the unmodified upstream file
